title: Clamped Discrete PID Controller with Anti-Windup
description: Deterministic fixed-step discrete-time PID control law in C99 featuring derivative filtering, output saturation clamping, and conditional integrator anti-windup.

title: Second-Order IIR Biquad Digital Filter
description: Direct-Form II Transposed biquadratic infinite-impulse-response digital filter in C99 for real-time sensor anti-aliasing and notch attenuation.

title: Fixed-Step Kalman Filter State Estimator
description: Two-state position-velocity linear Kalman filter in C99 separated into a reusable header API and prediction-update estimation implementation.

title: Clarke/Park Field-Oriented Control (FOC) Motor Drive
description: Real-time PMSM Field-Oriented Control firmware implementing Clarke/Park transforms, dq PI current regulation, and Space-Vector PWM duty cycle modulation across header modules.

title: Embedded BMS State-of-Charge EKF and Safety Firmware
description: Multi-file lithium-ion Battery Management System (BMS) firmware integrating an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) SoC estimator with over-voltage and thermal safety limits.
